made_with.what: model: made for the first world by this framework: code-built pieces baked with the surface library, or Pixal3D models from generated close-ups

refine_options.action: re-make from the plan with a code-built body
refine_options.does: a coding agent writes a code builder for its kind from its plan and inventory row, built exactly and baked with the library (no generated mesh)
the surface line again: finish map, library names, split by finish, painted and baked from the surface library (never the picture's colours)
its place's picture sets baked again at a higher texel density (more texels a metre for its set)
a new close-up, Pixal3D take, closed into a solid and the surface line
